name: Stability Ball Single-Leg Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with one heel on the ball and both arms on the floor for balance.
Lift the other leg clear and press through the supported heel to raise your hips into a bridge.
Keeping your hips elevated, bend your working knee to roll the ball smoothly in toward your glute by contracting your hamstring.
Roll the ball slowly back out to a straight working leg without dropping your hips, and switch sides after finishing one leg.
tips: Keep your pelvis level and high rather than letting your hips sink or twist sideways.
Move slowly because balancing the ball on one heel requires steady hamstring and core control.
